# Model pricing

Generated from `common/runners/cost.py`, the same table that estimates cost
before a run and decides whether to ask for confirmation. Editing this file
changes nothing — edit `PRICE_TABLE` and regenerate.

Figures are conservative per-unit USD, snapshotted from vendor pricing pages.
Actual cost may come in slightly lower; it should never come in higher. Batch
totals quoted elsewhere in the skills are these numbers multiplied by the item
count, not separate prices.

## Confirmation thresholds

A single call estimated above **$0.10** prompts before running.
Pass `--yes` to skip the prompt. An unknown model estimates as `None`, which
never prompts — unknown is not the same as free, so check the vendor's page.

Batch runs ask once for the aggregate instead of once per item, and warn when
the total exceeds the per-modality budget:

| Modality | Default budget | Env override |
|---|---|---|
| carousel | $1.50 | `SKILLS_CAROUSEL_BUDGET` |
| reel | $4.00 | `SKILLS_REEL_BUDGET` |
| research | $0.00 | `SKILLS_RESEARCH_BUDGET` |
